scope: Project Rules Agent extraction, organization, independent review and publication. These are processing instructions, never scientific project R rules.

responsibility_boundary.compression: Identify and preserve PROJECT_FACT and PROJECT_ASSUMPTION in the reviewed context with their information status and source evidence. Preserve original requirement wording without publishing formal project rules.
responsibility_boundary.project_rules_agent: Reuse relevant reviewed context and re-read original sources to extract, classify, review and publish project requirements. Do not build a second project-fact or project-assumption extraction catalogue.
responsibility_boundary.missing_or_inconsistent_upstream_context: Return a source-linked correction request to compression; do not silently rewrite main.json or discard the discrepancy.
responsibility_boundary.implementation_status: REVIEW_DRAFT_ONLY; runtime adapters and schemas unchanged

inherits.delivery: Supply the applicable full shared text to fresh requests; do not rely on IDs alone.

settled_decisions.decision: Compression preserves original meaning; Project Rules Agent alone extracts and publishes formal project rules.
Formal rules have a separate artifact and consumption-stage/timing annotations.
Explicit authorized replacement relations permit updates while preserving prior versions; newer dates alone do not override.
Define a downstream applicability/compliance check contract now; connect its execution later.
Organized rules must be re-checked and re-validated; a prior draft review cannot approve changed final content.
PROJECT_FACT and PROJECT_ASSUMPTION identification belongs to compression. Project Rules Agent reuses and checks that context while extracting requirements; upstream omissions return to compression.

rules.title: Original sources and adoption status
rules.instruction: Recheck the original project materials. Activate a requirement only when its project authority and adoption status are supported.
checks: Read the original proposal and any explicitly designated protocols, supplements, clarifications and review decisions.
Distinguish draft, proposed, approved, withdrawn and superseded statements; do not infer status from filenames or dates.
Treat cited papers as evidence unless an authorized project statement explicitly adopts a specific requirement.

human_review.scope: PRC001 wording and its source-adoption-status gap recommendation; no runtime activation.
human_review.clarification: Existing explicit user authorization can be reused without requesting the same confirmation again.
human_review.change_policy: Re-review this rule if its approved meaning, scope or conditions change.

rules.title: Requirement classification and upstream context reuse
rules.instruction: Reuse project facts and assumptions identified by compression. Extract and classify candidate project requirements from original materials; do not repeat upstream fact or assumption extraction. Only supported binding requirements enter the active rule collection.
checks: Reference the relevant reviewed main.json content and source evidence; keep source-stated facts and assumptions distinct without treating either as independently verified.
For a mixed statement, extract any explicit obligation to use an assumption and link it to the upstream assumption; the assumption does not become a verified fact.
Distinguish binding requirements from literature facts, candidate suggestions and unresolved requirement statements.
Record non-rule source coverage and exclusion reasons without recreating the upstream fact or assumption catalogue.
If original materials expose missing or inconsistent upstream facts or assumptions, request a source-linked compression correction; do not silently rewrite the context.

human_review.decision_quote: `PROJECT_FACT` 和 `PROJECT_ASSUMPTION`  这一部分需要在compression中完成
human_review.scope: Move project-fact and project-assumption identification to compression; retain requirement extraction and verification in Project Rules Agent. This replaces the earlier ownership recommendation; no runtime activation.
human_review.clarification: The previous approval does not approve changed final wording. The ownership correction is user-directed; remaining rule-by-rule review continues.
human_review.change_policy: Re-review this rule if its approved meaning, scope or conditions change.

review_history.title: Statement classification
review_history.instruction: Distinguish project objectives, facts, assumptions, binding requirements, literature facts, suggestions and unresolved statements. Only supported binding requirements enter the active rule collection.
checks: Separate mixed statements while preserving their relationships and source evidence.
Distinguish an assumption from an explicit requirement to use that assumption.
Retain non-rule statements and classification reasons in the audit.

human_review.scope: PRC002 wording and the recommendation to add PROJECT_FACT and PROJECT_ASSUMPTION; no runtime activation.
human_review.clarification: An obligation to use an assumption does not make that assumption a verified fact.
human_review.change_policy: Re-review this rule if its approved meaning, scope or conditions change.

review_history.superseded_scope: Extraction ownership for project facts and assumptions; replaced by the user's explicit compression-ownership correction.

rules.title: Preserve complete requirement meaning
rules.instruction: Preserve each requirement's original meaning, strength, scope, conditions and exceptions during extraction and organization.
checks: Interpret must, should, may, must not and only if in context; keywords alone do not establish obligation strength.
Preserve the actor or target, logical operators, timing, triggers and exceptions, including linked qualifications across paragraphs, tables and footnotes.
Apply the relevant 13-category scientific preservation checklist and its versioned PK terminology appendix; do not import compression-only workflow instructions.
Keep unstated or ambiguous details explicit. Do not invent thresholds, applicability, permissions or conditions.
rules.on_failure: Return a source-linked revision or clarification finding. Never silently repair or strengthen the requirement.

rule.title: Complete obligation meaning
rule.instruction: Preserve the actor or target, obligation or prohibition, scope, trigger, conditions, exceptions and all consequential scientific definitions. Formatting or consolidation must not change logical operators or obligation strength.
checks: Distinguish must, may, should, must not and only if using the original context; unresolved strength requires clarification.
Use the complete applicable 13-category preservation profile without requiring unstated scientific data.
Keep linked conditions from multiple paragraphs together; no invented thresholds, freeze conditions or parameter permissions.

human_review.scope: The exact PRC003 title, instruction, four checks and on_failure text presented immediately before this decision.
human_review.clarification: Approval of this rule text only; other pending PRC rules remain pending and runtime activation is unchanged.
human_review.change_policy: Re-review if the approved meaning, scope or conditions change.

rules.title: Verify meaning and adoption evidence
rules.instruction: Check separately that the source supports the complete requirement and that authorized project evidence supports its adoption.
checks: Link each consequential clause to exact source spans and their context; quotation matching alone does not establish meaning.
Verify project adoption and its scope. Read permission, document type or publication status alone does not authorize a requirement.
Check relevant cross-references and contradictory evidence; do not select only passages supporting the proposed rule.
Distinguish unavailable, unreadable, unsearched, searched-but-not-found and explicitly absent evidence.
rules.on_failure: Keep unsupported requirements unpublished and identify whether meaning, adoption or evidence access requires clarification.

rule.title: Evidence support and authority support
rule.instruction: Check separately that cited text supports the rule's meaning and that a permitted project source authorizes its adoption. Exact quotation matching alone is insufficient.
checks: Link each consequential clause and qualifier to source spans, including cross-references.
The independent reviewer must test entailment, counterevidence and permission scope, not just quote existence.
Unprovided, unreadable, unsearched, searched-but-not-found and explicitly absent evidence are different states.

human_review.scope: The exact PRC004 title, instruction, four checks and on_failure text presented before this decision.
human_review.clarification: The user clarified agreement after the ambiguous message. PRC003 and PRC004 remain separate. Approval covers this rule only; other pending rules remain pending and runtime activation is unchanged.
human_review.change_policy: Re-review if the approved meaning, scope or conditions change.

rules.title: Consolidate without losing meaning
rules.instruction: Remove duplication while preserving every distinct obligation, qualification and source.
checks: Merge exact duplicates only after confirming identical meaning, obligation strength, applicability, conditions and exceptions.
For semantic merging or splitting, preserve each original obligation and review the resulting text against all contributing source clauses.
Keep requirements separate when consolidation would hide different scopes, conditions, permissions or prohibitions.
Retain all source references and traceable mappings from original clauses to final rules.
rules.on_failure: Keep the affected requirements separate and report the specific ambiguity or conflict for resolution.

rule.title: Consolidation without loss
rule.instruction: Consolidate only obligations with compatible meaning and scope. Preserve each distinct qualifier, source and source-to-final-rule mapping.
checks: Retain exact-duplicate merging as the deterministic baseline.
If semantic merging, splitting or wording changes are proposed, review the resulting text and all contributing original clauses.
A mixed permitted/prohibited or conditional statement must not become a blanket rule.

human_review.decision_quote: 同意 但是这些是不是在general rules已经有了像这些通用的应该放在general里而不是单独的对吧 recheck this part for me
human_review.scope: The previously presented PRC005 content is accepted; the user requested a general-versus-module ownership review. This does not approve retaining PRC005 as a separate rule or activate runtime changes.
human_review.change_policy: Keep the approved text in history when relocating it. Changed meaning or newly proposed shared wording remains subject to review.

placement_review.implementation: Ownership review only; no runtime activation, renumbering or deletion of approved history.

rules.title: Explicit amendments and conflicts
rules.instruction: An authorized clarification or review decision may replace an earlier requirement only through an explicit, traceable replacement relation that identifies the affected requirement, scope and activation condition. A newer date alone does not override an older source.
checks: Record the predecessor artifact/version and rule or original source clause; identify exactly what changes and what remains.
Retain old versions, evidence and the amendment decision; do not silently merge contradictory obligations.
Missing authority, ambiguous replacement scope or unresolved conflicts block the affected rule publication.

rules.title: Stage and biological applicability
rules.instruction: Record where a rule is consumed and distinguish source-stated applicability from a workflow mapping. Dispatch to a stage does not prove applicability to a particular dataset or analysis.
checks: Preserve species, population, matrix, free/total basis, endpoint and relevant study restrictions.
Allow an explicit UNASSIGNED routing state with a reason; never force a guessed stage to satisfy the schema.
Unknown scope is neither universal applicability nor permission to exclude the rule; downstream metadata must resolve relevant conditions.

rules.title: Material gaps and release decisions
rules.instruction: Distinguish uncertainty about an obligation from missing scientific information. An unresolved authority, meaning, conflict or required applicability decision blocks publication; a faithfully represented non-obligation or explicitly later-stage data gap may remain a warning.
checks: For every issue record its ID, affected field/rules, status, needed_at, impact, requested clarification/material and blocking reason.
Do not demand later-stage measurements now or invent extra project requirements to fill a gap.
Classify BLOCK_PUBLICATION versus WARN_OR_DEFER explicitly; an unknown with unresolved impact cannot be silently downgraded.

rules.title: Objective and effective-context consistency
rules.instruction: Check the rule collection against the source-supported project question and the effective scientific context. A pure objective is not a rule; a consequential restriction remains mandatory even when it limits the objective.
checks: Review semantic objective duplication, not only identical strings.
Compare obligations against relevant study, data-use, checks and uncertainty statements in main.json.

If an amendment changes the objective or leaves contradictory effective context, request the appropriate context revision before publishing a consistent handoff; do not silently rewrite the objective.

rules.title: Identity and time semantics
rules.instruction: Keep source citations, dataset identifiers, workflow phases and scientific observation windows distinct. Assign only identifiers supplied by the host.
checks: Before allocation, leave downstream task/dataset ID lists empty; preserve restrictions in text and typed scope.
Separate observation_window from required_phase, trigger and scientific deadline; do not infer one from another.
Use NOT_SPECIFIED for unstated scalar values; add an explicit applicability-status field so an empty array does not mean universal scope.

rules.title: Re-check the final organized rule package
rules.instruction: Independently re-check the organized candidate rule package against the original sources, then re-validate its contract before publication. Review approval binds the exact final content and scope.
checks: Perform faithfulness, completeness and global-conflict checks with separate recorded outcomes in a fresh reviewer invocation; they need not be three redundant model calls.
Require bidirectional source-unit, candidate-item and final-rule coverage; NO_REQUIREMENT cannot coexist with a mapped obligation supported by the same relevant source clauses.

Any change to meaning, conditions, exceptions, adoption, source or scope after review invalidates that review; create a new candidate and re-check. Retain failures, not repeated unchanged sampling for PASS.

rules.title: Publish and prepare for downstream re-validation
rules.instruction: Publish the active collection only in project_rules.json and reference it from main.json. Deliver complete applicable rule records and a version-bound contract for later checks at each consuming stage.
checks: Before release, validate publication status, exact reviewed content, source references, replacement lineage and effective-main binding.
At use, re-validate the rule version, project/task binding and applicable conditions; a usage label is not evidence of compliance.
Downstream check records distinguish applicability from compliance. Execution of these checkpoints is deferred in this iteration by user decision.

scientific_preservation_profile.delivery: Reuse the full approved category details through a module-appropriate versioned profile; category names alone are not sufficient instructions.

proposed_flow: Receive reviewed facts and assumptions from compression; extract candidate project requirements from original materials
Deterministically organize a candidate rule package and its source mappings; do not publish
Fresh independent reviewer re-checks that organized package against all admitted original sources
Host re-validates schema, mappings, bindings, release conditions and final reviewed content
Publish immutable project_rules.json and the effective main reference
At downstream use, re-validate identity and applicability; execution adapter is deferred
review_efficiency: Organize the candidate before independent semantic review so the reviewer sees the final content. If no scientific content changes afterward, final publication uses deterministic validation. If it changes, a new semantic review is required. This does not implement project-wide selective reruns.

qualification.method: Human-labeled withheld examples and real-model blind evaluation, including known critical semantic errors and valid negative cases.
qualification.metrics: Agree acceptance criteria before the evaluation; offline fixture PASS is not real-model accuracy.
